mechanism: Tramadol inhibits norepinephrine reuptake and can cause hypertension; combined with potassium supplementation increases hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or on concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and blood pressure; assess renal function; consider alternative analgesics if potassium supplementation is essential or adjust potassium dosing based on levels.
